name: Emma Webb’s Reciprocal Links
author: emmawebb19976

sections.description:
So back in the old days, adult sites had a link chain network. Massive farms of adult sites would link themselves together, and we would spend hours caught within the sites, just viewing them one after the other, the actual definition of the term “Rabbit Hole”. This plugin works the same way. You set it up, place [ewrl_submit] on a page, and let site owners submit their links. You can manually accept or wait until they link back to you. Some website owners may give you the benefit of the doubt and link to you without submitting. This will come up on your dashboard, you can accept or deny it based on their content.

Add shortcode to a page or widget [ewrl_links] to show the list. The more traffic you are sent, the higher they go up on the list. This creates a massive eco-system of sites all bonded together with traffic flowing around like water. If a person deletes your link, your system will remove them without discrimination, so you won’t get conned. I had this developed for my site and I am happy to share it as improves the echo-system. Visit my site www.emmawebb.co.uk to see it live in action. Add me as your first link, and within a day or two, you’ll see yourself appear on my site and you’ll get my traffic. And I heavily advertise my site, so it’s worth it.

The widget and code has no set theme, it pulls right from your theme settings, so you it will organically fit in with your site’s appearance.

A daily check requests only the backlink page the submitter entered, to see if your domain is still on that page. No screenshots are loaded. The plugin does not call WordPress.com, Google Analytics, or the author’s server.

Any questions, feel free to contact me from my site. If you have any requests on some cool updates, I’ll gladly add those too.

Privacy

The public form stores the site name, site URL, backlink URL, and description the visitor types. A short-lived transient limits repeat submissions from the same address. Incoming referrer hostnames are stored locally. The daily backlink check requests the partner URL stored with an approved link. Nothing is sent to a third-party analytics or screenshot service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the emma-webbs-reciprocal-links folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Add [ewrl_submit] to the request page.
  4. Add [ewrl_links] to the page that should link back, or add the Reciprocal links widget.
  5. Review requests under Reciprocal links.
